sourceurl.description: Base URL of the crate registry index from which these crates were projected, e.g. 'https://index.crates.io'. This records provenance only; a crate name denotes the same crate whichever registry serves it.

crates.description: A Rust crate (library or binary) published to the registry.

name.description: The canonical crate name exactly as published, preserving its case. This is the authoritative name of the crate; the crateid is only an addressing key and MAY be a hash where two crate names collide case-insensitively.

num.description: The exact upstream crate version string as published, including any build metadata. This is the authoritative version value; versionid is a derived identifier and MUST NOT be parsed as a version.

homepage.description: The homepage URL declared in the package.homepage field of Cargo.toml for this version.

repository.description: The source repository URL declared in the package.repository field of Cargo.toml for this version.

categories.description: Category slugs that the crate belongs to, declared in package.categories of Cargo.toml for this version.

keywords.description: Keywords that describe the crate, declared in package.keywords of Cargo.toml for this version.

license.description: The SPDX license expression for this version, taken from package.license in Cargo.toml. This is a version-level field: crates.io does not report a license on the crate object. The value is an expression and MAY combine identifiers with OR/AND; it MUST NOT be split into a list. ABSENT when the version declares only license_file, or neither.

license_file.description: The repository-relative path of a license file, taken from package.license-file in Cargo.toml, used when the license is not expressible as an SPDX expression. A version MAY legitimately declare neither license nor license_file.

downloads.description: Download count for this specific version.

crate_size.description: The size, in bytes, of the published .crate archive for this version.

cksum.description: The lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 checksum of the published .crate archive, as recorded in the registry index. This is the integrity anchor for the artifact.

dl_path.description: The registry-relative path from which the .crate archive for this version is downloaded.

readme_path.description: The registry-relative path from which the rendered README for this version is retrieved.

features.description: The Cargo feature table for this version: each feature name maps to the list of features it enables. Only features representable in the version 1 index format appear here; the remainder appear in features2.

features2.description: Additional Cargo features that require index format version 2 or later, namely features referencing weak dependencies (dep_name?/feat_name) or explicit dependency activation (dep:dep_name). Consumers MUST merge features2 into features.

v.description: The registry index schema version of this version's index entry. The value 2 signals that features2 MAY be present. A consumer that does not understand the value MUST refuse to use the entry.

rust_version.description: The minimum supported Rust version (MSRV) declared in package.rust-version of Cargo.toml for this version.

edition.description: The Rust language edition declared in package.edition of Cargo.toml for this version.

lib_links.description: The name of the native library this version links against, declared in the package.links key of Cargo.toml. Cargo names this manifest key links; it is named lib_links here, as crates.io does, to avoid colliding with the crate-level hypermedia links object, which is modelled as crate_links.

has_lib.description: Whether this version publishes a library target.

bin_names.description: The names of the binary targets published by this version.

yanked.description: Whether this specific version has been yanked. A yanked version remains downloadable; yanking only prevents new dependency resolutions from selecting it.

yank_message.description: The operator-supplied explanation recorded when this version was yanked. ABSENT when the version is not yanked or when no message was supplied.

published_by.description: The registry user account that published this version. ABSENT for versions published before crates.io began recording the publisher.

login.description: The login name of the user.

name.description: The display name of the user.

url.description: The URL of the user's profile.

avatar.description: The URL of the user's avatar image.

audit_actions.description: The recorded lifecycle actions for this version, such as publish, yank and unyank, in chronological order.

time.description: The time at which the action was performed.

user.description: The registry user account that performed the action.

login.description: The login name of the user.

name.description: The display name of the user.

url.description: The URL of the user's profile.

avatar.description: The URL of the user's avatar image.

dependencies.description: The dependencies declared by this version, as recorded in the deps array of the registry index entry.

name.description: The name the dependency is referred to by within this crate. When the dependency was renamed this is the local alias, and the package attribute carries the real crate name.

req.description: The Cargo semver requirement string the dependency version must satisfy, for example ^1.0.

features.description: The features of the dependency explicitly enabled by this crate.

optional.description: Whether the dependency is optional. This is the upstream index field name and is unrelated to xRegistry attribute optionality.

default_features.description: Whether the default features of the dependency are enabled. This is the upstream index field name.

target.description: The Cargo target platform expression that gates this dependency, for example cfg(windows). ABSENT when the dependency is unconditional.

registry.description: The index URL of the registry the dependency is resolved from. ABSENT when the dependency comes from the same registry as this crate.

package.description: The real crate name when the dependency was renamed with the package key. ABSENT when the dependency was not renamed.

defaultversionsticky.description: Sticky default Versions are not supported: the default Version always tracks the registry-computed default_version.

default_version.description: The version crates.io designates as the crate's default, being the highest non-yanked, non-pre-release version where one exists. This is the upstream replacement for the deprecated max_version, max_stable_version and newest_version fields, and it is the value the xRegistry default Version corresponds to.

max_version.description: DEPRECATED upstream. The highest version by SemVer precedence, including pre-releases and yanked versions. Retained only for compatibility with existing crates.io clients; default_version is to be used instead.

max_stable_version.description: DEPRECATED upstream. The highest version by SemVer precedence excluding pre-releases. Retained only for compatibility with existing crates.io clients; default_version is to be used instead.

newest_version.description: DEPRECATED upstream. The most recently published version, which need not be the highest by SemVer precedence. Retained only for compatibility with existing crates.io clients; default_version is to be used instead.

num_versions.description: The number of versions published for this crate, including yanked versions.

downloads.description: Total all-time download count summed over every version of the crate.

recent_downloads.description: Download count for the crate over the trailing 90-day window.

yanked.description: Whether EVERY version of this crate has been yanked. It does not report the yank status of the default or the newest version; per-version yank status is carried by the Version-level yanked attribute.

trustpub_only.description: Whether the crate may only be published through Trusted Publishing, so that API tokens are rejected for new publishes.

owners.description: The users and teams authorized to publish new versions of the crate.

login.description: The login name of the user, or the qualified handle of the team.

name.description: The display name of the owner.

kind.description: Whether the owner is an individual user or a team.

url.description: The URL of the owner's profile.

avatar.description: The URL of the owner's avatar image.

crate_links.description: The crates.io CrateLinks structure: a fixed set of registry-relative paths to related crate endpoints. Every member is individually nullable upstream and is therefore ABSENT when not supplied. It is named crate_links, not links, because Cargo's manifest already defines a links key declaring a native library; that per-version value is modelled as lib_links.

version_downloads.description: The registry-relative path to the per-version download statistics for the crate.

versions.description: The registry-relative path to the crate's version list. ABSENT when the version list was already inlined in the response.

owners.description: The registry-relative path to the combined owner list for the crate.

owner_team.description: The registry-relative path to the team owners of the crate.

owner_user.description: The registry-relative path to the individual user owners of the crate.

reverse_dependencies.description: The registry-relative path to the crates that depend on this crate.
